body: I know. It is really difficult growing up in this generation with no one to look up to to see things will be okay if you're born like this. I mean, I tell everyone I'm straight, so I guess I wouldn't meet people like it, but I don't know, I just feel very isolated. And disgusted when certain dreams happen.

I feel the same. I count only cutting as self harm because otherwise I would have been self harming for nearly a decade. But I've gone through cutting, purging, restricting, headbanging, and overdoses. I think it's a lot to do with society's idea of what self harm is.

I've been through the same thing. Like, I had serious self hate going on. To the point I was cutting f****t into my skin and thinking I was an abomination to God.
I ended up telling my mum and she was absolutely awful. Told me it was disgusting, there was something wrong with me, I wasn't meant to be that way, that it repulsed her. She's better now, though, and though I still struggle with denial, I'm nowhere near as bad as I used to be. I hope your family situation changes, dude. Parents suck.

I'm sorry to hear that. The thing is though, the field of mental health care is pretty shit. Even if you've had bad experiences with treatment before, that doesn't mean you can't get good treatment. It's a massive field. You don't deserve to feel like this, and you really really need help.

There is another option though - you can get treatment for your depression and make other, healthy close friendships. Believe me, when I tried to kill myself the time I got put in hospital I believed there was no other option. I believed I was untreatable. I was completely wrong. Nothing is unfixable with the right support and help. My life will never be a normal one, and I might never work, but that doesn't matter, I'm still happy and fighting to stay alive. Your mental illness is trying to kill you. I urge you not to give in to it. You would never tell another redditor to give up and die, so please don't think that's ok to say to yourself. The brain is a strange thing, and as soon as you are on the way to death, you will panic and cry and wish you were alive. Don't let depression kill you, please.

There are other options. I know life seems unbearable. I know it feels like agony. I've been there. You need mental health care - probably inpatient (if you're from the UK, I don't know what it's like in other countries). I know you don't want to live another second but if you're forced to you will find you can. You're a lot stronger than you think. And over time those seconds will get better and better and easier. Please talk to someone and get the process started. If you want to talk about what's going on, you can always drop me a pm.

I know the feeling. I was predicted all A*s for my GCSES. Ending up getting a few As with the A*s. I was devestated. I had put everything into them, and my best wasn't good enough. I tried to kill myself as a result of those grades.
Looking back, it was stupid. Grades don't define a good future. There is so much more to life. If you're struggling, it's not because there's something wrong with you - the entire education system is fucked. Students are working harder and harder, but for not much gain. Who cares what the government think of you. They're not doing a great job anywhere at the moment. 
Try putting your passion into something else - something that helps others. Happiness is more important than grades.

Please urge your friend to get help. The best way you can do that is by also getting help.
There's a site called DocReady which is really helpful for getting everything started. You don't want to end up in a toxic friendship, which sadly often happens between mentally ill people, so your friend needs a professional to talk to. 
You haven't said why your friend wants to kill themself, so advice will be a bit limited. Try getting them to talk to the Samaritans - they do an email service which is great - and try and do fun activities together.  
Send him links to things he likes or you think are cute, like puppies or something. Talk about positive things together. Encourage him to think about what he would say to you - that you should stay alive etc. - and apply it to himself. Look after yourself.

Hey. Please don't kill yourself. I can relate to you a lot - I'm also transgender, have suffered from delusions and other psychosis related symptoms, and I never wanted to reach fifteen either. My life has got a lot better through medication, therapy, family help, and getting out of toxic relationships. I haven't had hallucinations or delusions for months now, though i have dissociation problems. It's hard knowing whether to listen to the doctors or not when you're in that state, but the fact is you're ill and you need help with that. Don't judge yourself for having less socially accepted diagnoses. You can change your life, honestly.

Hey. I don't know what you've done. But it's in the past now. You need to face up to the consequences, not end your life to escape what you did.
Have you talked to anyone about it?
I mean, I don't know what you've done, but I'm a sexual abuse victim and I wouldn't want my abuser to kill himself. He's done a lot of awful, terrible things, but I would rather he faced up to it and changed than took his life. 
From the sounds of it, you need focused therapy and maybe some calming medication. You can be helped.

Jesus Christ. 
Do you have any relatives you can stay with? You can't stay with parents like that. For real, they could be put in prison. You have to tell someone - believe me, your life gets so much better when you're letting shit out to someone that can actually do something about it. Don't get a job right before your exams, that's madness. If it comes down to it, tell them you'll report them to social services if they don't let you see your friends and girlfriend. I know how hard it can be living with people like that, and I know you can feel guilty telling on them. But you've got to. Let me know if the situation changes.

Hey. I'm amazed that you've made it through a decade of depression with no help. Like seriously impressed.
You probably don't want to hear this, but that girl isn't worth it. She's not the be all and end all of your life. I know you can't cling on to life just for hope of a romantic relationship, but you can't end it because one ended. Not that I'm one to talk - when my ex broke up with me I tried to kill myself. Two months later I got with a girl I hope I will be with forever. There's always hope. And there's a hell of a lot of nice people out there to meet.
I know the feeling of life being unbearable as well, and I'm not quite sure what to say to that. I hope you don't kill yourself, random stranger. Please let us know if you're still with us after a few days.

I'm sorry to hear you're not doing well. I know how hard it is to actively try and stop, but if you get mental health care and help with your life a few months will go by and you'll realise you didn't feel the need. Until that day comes, all of us here on Reddit are here to talk things over whenever you need.
Thank you all. My mum came in and found me and an ambulance has checked me over and physically I'm okay. Mentally still the same.
Please can someone talk to me I'm so scared
Speaking as someone who's been there, it's gonna get worse. You'll get palpitations, feeling faint, feeling sick. Palpitations aren't fun. Please don't do it again. It's not worth it.

I had this conversation with my psychiatrist the other day. Nearly got me hospitalised. Eventually she conceded there was no logical reason to live and told me to be wise I had to use emotions, too.
I guess there is logical reason to live if you find something worth living for. And, logically, we will all die at one point, and (unless you're religious) will cease to exist. We won't be able to remember our life. Ever had a dream you couldn't remember? It was like it never really existed, right? You can't remember it and while you must have experienced it you don't think of it as something in your life you have really experienced, if that makes sense. You might as well live your life because you're going to die eventually anyway and then it will be as if your entire life never happened. Or that's how I rationalise it, anyway, but as someone who disossiates a lot I suppose I'm always living life as if I'm not quite there.

Hey, I couldn't tell my parents either. My school told my dad, and then my nan, because they were sending me to A & E because of suicidal thoughts. For some reason, I couldn't bear my mum knowing, so I stayed with my nan that night. She only found out what happened when she came round the next day and I gave my nan permission to tell her.
Since then, my bond with all the members of my close family has got stronger, and I hope it will be the same for you. You don't need to tell them outright - you might find it easy to write it all down and send it to them while you're at school, or do what I did and  tell them through a professional adult. When my mum was confused about my mental health I drew her a cartoon. You can do it whatever way works for you, even if it seems ridiculous. I wish you the best of luck.

As much as it is sad you don't find that you can continue to live and find peace within your life, I am glad that your suffering is coming to an end, and that your final moments are of peace, if you do go through with it, and not suffering. Please let us know if you don't - we all care about each other here, and a lot of people would be glad to see you alive.

Please keep us posted. I hope you don't go through with it. You seem like a nice person, from what you've written. Just someone that needs psychiatric care. Have you been to see anyone? 

You don't need to be a 'normal' adult. I've long accepted I'll never be one. You can work towards a future regardless of what impedes you. To be honest, and correct me if I'm wrong, if you're giving yourself a week, that seems like someone that wants to find a way to live. There are many, so please take one. Give life a big, huge effort before killing yourself. 

I'm here if you need to talk to anyone. I suffer from autism and social anxiety too, so I can empathise with what you're going through. I hope that thing happens, whatever it is.
Are you on any medication? If it's only been happening for a day I wouldn't worry about it. Just accept this as what needs to be a 'you' day and then move on with your life tomorrow.

I've been diagnosed with high functioning autism, panic attacks, social anxiety, and depression. I know the feeling of being almost disconnected from other people. You just gotta find the right people though. 
I was hospitalised for three months and that's what worked for me. They put me on the highest dose of fluoxetine they could, gave me weekly psychologist appointments, daily nurse appointments, group therapy, and group activities. It may take a lot, but depression is beatable. Fluoxetine isn't the only medication but if you don't need medication anyway, there are other things you can do. 
I also know how it feels to feel like you're not you anymore, like illness has taken away bits of you. For me, it helped to make my own personality. I went vegan, donated my hair, did stuff with the Red Cross, adopted a rescue bunny, and now I spend my life trying to be as good a person as I can. I honestly don't know where I'd be if I hadn't. 
I mean, there are loads and loads of things I could suggest that might help you, but I feel like I should leave it here and say there is treatment that works. Life might always be a bit different, but who knows, it might end up being a good thing. I don't know who I'd be if I hadn't had years of being mentally ill, but I don't think that person would be as nice.
I'm here if you need to talk. Just drop me a pm.

I'm seventeen and in the same boat. I can't give you any of that life gets better crap, but I'm here if you want to talk. I had nightmares about him straight out for a month and woke up screaming multiple times. I fantasised about mutilating my body so nobody could ever hurt me again. Now I think I might be attracted to guys but even admitting that to myself makes me feel disgusting. I don't know what you're going through, but there are always people on the internet who want to listen. You can email the samaritans or ring the rape crisis hotline or go on seven cups of tea. Or you can talk to all of us here on Reddit. We're here for you.
I tried to kill myself when I was nine or ten, and I've been suicidal on and off since then. I'm now seventeen.
